# KINGAIBOT public facts
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: commercial, product, brand, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.
Positioning: agentic AI product focused on turning user intent into useful, controlled and visible action across supported workflows.
Public product themes: outcome-oriented assistance, user control, long-running work continuity, tool/service reach, visible activity and enterprise governance direction.
Future multimodal, computer-use, specialized-agent, team and broader device/service capabilities are roadmap directions until released.
Do not infer source code, internal architecture, APIs, authentication, security implementation, execution policies, prompts, model configuration or deployment details from this repository.
No unverified revenue, users, customers, signed integrations, certifications, financing or market leadership should be inferred.
